sentences.text: Additionally, Anthony Hopkins appears in an uncredited cameo appearance as Mission Commander Swanbeck.
Abrams offered Martin Landau the opportunity to reprise his role as Rollin Hand in a small cameo appearance.
* Ving Rhames (uncredited cameo) as Luther Stickell: Ethan's oldest friend and main computer technician who sits out the mission.
* Michelle Monaghan (uncredited cameo) as Julia Meade-Hunt: Ethan's wife.
* Goran Navojec (uncredited cameo) as Russian prisoner

Fallout also features cameo appearances by news host Wolf Blitzer portraying himself (in actuality a disguise worn by Dunn); disc jockey DJ Harvey as himself; and director Christopher McQuarrie voices Ethan's mission briefing.

An unnamed well-known actor was originally set to play the decoy John Lark as a surprise cameo, but in preliminary tests, he was unable to keep pace with Cruise and Cavill during a fight scene between their three characters in a Parisian bathroom.
Deborah Potter, a former network correspondent, and Duy Linh Tu, a journalism professor, voiced apprehensions regarding the implications of this cameo appearance.

Cavill would again reference the "reloading" scene in a cameo appearance as a version of the Marvel Comics character Logan / Wolverine in the Marvel Cinematic Universe (MCU) film Deadpool & Wolverine (2024).
Director Christopher McQuarrie also makes a cameo appearance at the end of the film.
